Release notes 2.4

Version 2.4 introduces streaming responses for every endpoint. Clients that set the Accept header to text/event-stream receive incremental chunks instead of one buffered body, which cuts time to first byte for large exports.

The retry policy now honours Retry-After on both 429 and 503 responses, waiting at most thirty seconds before giving up and surfacing the error to the caller.

Deprecated: the legacy /v1/export route will be removed in 3.0; migrate to /v2/export, which supports the same filters plus cursor pagination.
